notes: Complete multi-colour redesign of every page: dark sidebar, new stat cards, clean filter bars (no scrollbars), better tables, and a fixed Map Scraper search.
Modules: CRM (always on) and Prospecting (super admin can switch it off – its tabs and settings disappear). Settings are now organised by module tabs.
Roles: Super admin, Admin / Manager, Sales person. New Team & Roles page, add/edit members, deactivate, last sign-in. Sales people see only their own and unassigned leads.
New full-page 'Add lead' form and CSV import page (no more popups).

Appointments: managed in Setu with optional Google Calendar sync – busy times block slots, bookings create calendar events with Google Meet links, cancellations remove them. Redesigned booking page (one day of slots at a time, readable colours).

API Usage & Costs: every AI, Google Places, SerpAPI, PageSpeed, WhatsApp, voice (Sarvam etc.), email and Calendar call is counted, with free limits, month-end projection and estimated cost. Prices are editable.

Lead capture field mapping: fields are learned from the first enquiry and can be mapped per source; Elementor (simple and Advanced data) supported. Clear guidance: use the webhook OR the script, not both.
Email: PHP mail works by default; SMTP is optional.
Report v3: landscape PDF, no header/footer, Inter fonts (no more '?' characters), high-quality charts, value-first content with real market stats, realistic outcomes and a 90-day plan.
